notes: Frames are derived from the approved v3 static art, not a newly illustrated full-body animation set.
Walks articulate the lower legs and add a one-pixel body bob. Motion offsets must also be applied.
Auras have separate back and front layers and are gated by runtime.mjs.
Monster base-species clips are exported; the same pose() functions can animate pool-specific variants.
Idle/swim loops for all 23 individual pool creatures are included.
Audio, damage, AP/MP, turn timers and live game integration are not implemented by these exports.
